s: Purpose-built store for embedding similarity search - retrieval backbone of modern AI apps.
w: Documents embed into high-dimensional vectors indexed by ANN structures (HNSW graphs, IVF clusters). Queries embed then traverse indexes returning approximate nearest neighbors in milliseconds with configurable recall/latency knobs. Metadata filters combine with similarity (hybrid filtering). Consistency depends on store - many are eventually consistent replicas.
use: RAG retrieval over corporate knowledge bases
avoid: Tiny datasets where pgvector on existing postgres suffices - don't add infrastructure

props.ef_search: Recall vs latency knob at query time

pat.d: Vector hits become citations/context injected into prompts.
BM25 keyword ∪ vector semantic merged by reranker.

pits: Embedding model drift invalidates whole index - version vectors with model ids, plan re-embedding pipelines
Recall silently degrades with wrong ef params - benchmark recall@k regularly
tips: Explain recall/latency/cost triangle; mention pgvector as pragmatic default for small/mid scale
